headline: Iran claims missile strike on US base in Jordan after US attacks

headline_marked: Tawhid Hridoy [[hits double century abroad]] in match vs South Africa 'A'
headline: Tawhid Hridoy hits double century abroad in match vs South Africa 'A'
summary: The Bangladesh 'A' skipper joins an elite list of batters to score first-class double tons overseas, alongside Shakib Al Hasan and Mushfiqur Rahim.
details: Bangladesh 'A' captain Tawhid Hridoy scored a brilliant double century against South Africa 'A' on the third day of the second four-day match at NWC Oval in Potchefstroom.
Hridoy reached his double hundred off 335 balls, hitting 22 fours and a six, helping the visitors close in on the hosts' first-innings total.
The 24-year-old joined an elite group of Bangladesh batters to score first-class double centuries abroad, a feat previously achieved by Mushfiqur Rahim, Shakib Al Hasan, and Shahriar Hossain.
Mushfiqur scored an unbeaten 200 in 2013 and Shakib made 217 in 2017, both in Test cricket, while Shahriar Hossain scored 218 in Karachi in 2003.
Other notable performances included Jaker Ali, who scored 94 off 168 balls, and Mohammad Saifuddin, who hit 87 off 171 balls.
Hridoy and Saifuddin shared a 185-run partnership for the sixth wicket.
Bangladesh 'A' finished the day on 471 for six, trailing South Africa 'A' by 41 runs after the hosts posted 512 in their first innings.
caption:
Tawhid Hridoy joins the elite ranks! 🏏

The Bangladesh 'A' skipper has smashed a double century in South Africa.

Bangladesh 'A' captain Tawhid Hridoy scored a brilliant double century against South Africa 'A' on the third day of the second four-day match at NWC Oval in Potchefstroom.

Hridoy reached his double hundred off 335 balls, hitting 22 fours and a six, helping the visitors close in on the hosts' first-innings total.

The 24-year-old joined an elite group of Bangladesh batters to score first-class double centuries abroad, a feat previously achieved by Mushfiqur Rahim, Shakib Al Hasan, and Shahriar Hossain.

Mushfiqur scored an unbeaten 200 in 2013 and Shakib made 217 in 2017, both in Test cricket, while Shahriar Hossain scored 218 in Karachi in 2003.

Other notable performances included Jaker Ali, who scored 94 off 168 balls, and Mohammad Saifuddin, who hit 87 off 171 balls.

Hridoy and Saifuddin shared a 185-run partnership for the sixth wicket.

Bangladesh 'A' finished the day on 471 for six, trailing South Africa 'A' by 41 runs after the hosts posted 512 in their first innings.
